snippet.title: Elzypon Trailer
snippet.description:
Elzypon is metaphysical pedagogy disguised as a turn-based RPG.

Thematically centered on Western Qabalah, Elzypon is a surrealist turn-based RPG drenched in myth, symbolism and  and hypnogogic irony

One first incarnates in the temple of Malkuth as a wanderer, a soul given the immense task of large scale amelioration (It's a lot, i know). You must climb the tree of life, facing the trials and tribulations presented to you in each sphere in the form of archetypal vices and thoughtforms wishing to inhabit your psyche. It's requisite that one truly knows themselves if they're ever to bridge the light down from Kether and into Malkuth.

You can wishlist it on steam here: linktr.ee/neolumism
